text: Kannada p.13 prints the total of mantras as ೧೦೦೫೨ (10052) while p.12 and the table print 10552; applied as printed (English now 10,052)
Kannada p.14 gives the Mandala as ಹದಿಮೂರನೆಯ (13th) in the sentence on Sarasvati, Ila, Bharati; the Rigveda has 10 Mandalas; applied as printed
Kannada p.14 gives 1017 suktas plus 11 Valakhilya = 1028 while the table on p.12 totals 1028 suktas without them; applied as printed (English now 1,017 and 1,028)
Kannada p.7 names Mahadeva as author of the Vaijayanti; applied as printed (English had Yadavaprakasha)

Kannada p.49 quotes the Divyavadana with viMshatidhaa in the first clause and paMchaviMshatidhaa in the last; p.50 says 20+5 = 25 divisions and that the ancient text must have had 21; applied as printed (English now 20 and 25)

Kannada p.47 names the Rigvedic Paila (Pailo hOtaa vasOH putraH) while English front matter/contents and later pages (e.g. Shailalaka) use Shaila; this reading changed pp.47-48 only; the rest of the volume needs the same check
Kannada p.66 says that of the 11 Valakhilya suktas the mention of ten is found in Macdonell Sarvanukramani; applied as printed (English now: ten of 11)
Kannada p.67 prints 99 suktas for the 8th mandala of the Bashkala shakha; added to the English as printed
Kannada p.77 prints Vanaparva adhyaya 134 for the Kahola/Ashtavakra verses (applied as printed; English had 132)
Kannada p.90 prints fifteen (ಪಂಚದಶಧಾ) for the Bhartrihari variant; applied as printed (English had seventeen)
Kannada p.100 numbers the Kāṇva-branch list ೧, ೩, ೩, ೪ ... (no ೨); applied as printed (English row for Kaṭhāḥ now 3)

Kannada p.113 prints anuvāka ೩ for adhyāyas 2, 9, 12, 13, 14, 16, 18 where the English had 7, and ೩೬ as the second-dashaka total (summary table prints ೭೬); the column sums then differ from the printed totals 111 and 76; applied as printed; the English italic remark under the tables (sums agree) is now untrue
Kannada p.114 prints ೧೧ anuvākas for adhyāya 25 and ೫೧ mantras for adhyāya 29; the third-dashaka sums (98 and 555) then differ from the printed totals ೯೭ and ೫೫೪; applied as printed
Kannada p.117 prints ೩೩ mantras for adhyāya 18 and ೧೨೨ yajus for adhyāya 30 (English had 77 and 177); the mantra column then no longer adds to the printed total 1975; applied as printed
Kannada p.121 prints ೬೯೦೦—೨೫೨೩=೪೦೭೭; the subtraction gives 4377; applied as printed (English now 6900 − 2523 = 4077)
Kannada p.121 stray line prints [ ೦೫ ] where the English had [15]; applied as printed ([05])

Kannada p.138 kanda 1 total ೩೨೪ (English had 342; the column of the rows sums to 342); kanda 3 shows only four rows against the total 5 / 55 / 206 (the English fifth row 5, 11, 36 is removed, dashes put in its place); kanda 7 row 2 prints ೨೦ ೫೧ and the total row prints — ೧೦೭ ೨೫೨ (English had 21 and 5 / 108); applied as printed. The English table note about 652 against 651 is now out of date

Kannada p.139 prints 44+6+4+25=82 (the sum is 79); first-kanda adhyāya 8 prints ೧೧ ೬೭ against the printed totals 78 and 499 (the rows then sum to 79 and 529); third-kanda last row has no adhyāya number and no anuvāka count (English had 12 and 9); applied as printed; the English note about the third kanda and the sum 784 is unchanged
Kannada p.142 prints ೩೨ for both the Vaimānika (Vaikhānasa) and the Bāṇḍikīya (Khāṇḍikīya) headings, then ೩೩-೩೭, ೩೮; the English had 31 for the first; applied as printed (32)
Kannada p.150 prints the Kauthuma total ಒಟ್ಟು ೨೨೨ and Caland's number ೧೮೯ (rows 1197+294+1026+205 sum to 2722; the English had 2722 and 1869); applied as printed

Kannada p.151 prints 959 more mantras for the Jaiminīya branch and 3681 in all, 182 fewer for Caland's 1687; the Kauthuma figures do not fit both (3681-959=2722, the p.150 total); English had 95; applied as printed (959)
Kannada pp.153-154 print the branch numbers ೧೨ (Kālabavinaḥ, after ೯), ೧೧ (Śāṭkāyaninaḥ), ೨ (Rauriki, before ೧೩), ೧೫, ೧೬; the English had 10 and 12; applied as printed (12 and 2)
Kannada p.156 prints the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa reference as (೨-೩೫-೭೧ ಮತ್ತು ೨), the English had 71 and 72; applied as printed (71 and 2)

English p.164 note 'The figures are not reproduced because their digits are unreadable' stands beside the figures 4627 and 4432, which agree with Kannada ೪೬೨೭ and ೪೪೩೨; remark left, the digits can now be read
Kannada p.165 numbers the branch heading ೨. ಬ್ರಹ್ಮವದಾಃ after ೬. ಜಲದಾಶಿ and before ೮; English had 7; applied as printed (2)
Kannada p.166 prints ೬೦೨೦ ಋಕ್ಕುಗಳು for the Cāraṇavaidya saṃhitā while its quoted verse says six thousand and twenty-six (ṣaṭsahasram … ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ); the English prose 6020 stands as printed
Kannada p.173 says the Kauṣītakī-brāhmaṇa follows the Bāṣkala branch although p.172 equates the Kauṣītakī brāhmaṇa with the Śāṅkhāyana branch; English changed to Bashkala as printed
Kannada p.181 heading prints ವಾಸಿಷ್ಠರು—೮ while its seven names and the p.182 table give 7; the English heading carries 8 as printed
Kannada p.202 prints [0] for ವಿಹವ್ಯಃ ಆಂಗಿರಸಃ 10-128 (no mantras); English keeps [0] as printed
Kannada p.224 table prints ೭ ೧ ೦ (7-1-0) for agnim naro....; impossible reference, applied as printed (English was 7-1-1)
Kannada p.239 numbers the points (೪) then (೬), skipping 5, and prints the (೬) line twice (second line has Yaska correctly); applied as printed ((6))
Kannada p.240 prints Anandatirtha 1197-1237 while the Kannada text says he lived 80 years; applied as printed (English was 1197-1277)
The supplied Kannada p. 215 is a copy of p. 216 (running head 216); the true p. 215 text is not in the file, so English p. 215 could not be checked (the supplied file needs a new p. 215)
Kannada p.241 prints 101 suktas of the Rigveda while the quoted Sanskrit says thousand-and-one (ekottarasahasra); applied as printed (English had 1,001)
Kannada p.271 numbers the Adityadarshana section ೩ although the list had reached ೬ (Halayudha) on p.270 and ೮ (Devapala) follows on p.272; applied as printed (English was 7)
Kannada p.276 prints Kshura as about C.E. ೧೯೦ (190), although Sayana (14th c.) quotes him; applied as printed (English was 1290)
Kannada p.277 numbers the Venkatesha section 2 (Arabic numeral) after ೬ Sayana; applied as printed (English was 7)
Kannada p.283 numbers the Gunavishnu section ೨ after ೬ Shobhakara; applied as printed (English was 7)
Kannada p.291 numbers the Atharvaveda Pada-patha section ೨ after ೬ Samaveda; applied as printed (English was 7)
Kannada p.300 gives the Hiranyagarbha hymn as Mandala 10, hymn 124; applied as printed (English had Mandala 1, ninth section)
Kannada p.305 number row prints ೧೩ after ೧೧ ೧೧ (words 10 11 11 13 12 12) in the Kramapatha example; clearly a misprint for 12; English has 12 (Devanagari line, derived data); English kept
Kannada p.306 Jata formulas print ೯ and ೮ in "೨+೩+೩+೨+೯+೩" and "೪+೫+೫+೪+೮+೫"; clearly misprints for 2 and 4; English has 2 and 4; English kept

Scholars' names on pp. 310–311 were changed to the Kannada forms (Burnouf, Voltaire, Bopp removed as not in the print; "Rorse", "Roth and Bothling", Bollensen as printed): look at these names once with a scholar

Kannada prints 13 in the word-number row (p. 305) and 9 and 8 in the Jata formulas (p. 306); the reader judged these misprints and kept the English instead of applying them as printed (deviation from the numbers rule, three places)
Kannada p.345 is marked NOT IN THE SUPPLIED TEXT; the English has no p.345 section (verse 1 begins at p.346); nothing read

Kannada p.351 prints the Rgveda reference ಋ. ೧-೧೬೪-೮೬ (1-164-86), although RV 1.164 has fewer verses and the embedded English on pp.352-353 says R.V. I.164.46; English has 1-164-86 as printed; kept as printed
Kannada p.354 prints the Chandogya reference ಛಾ. ಉ. ೭-೧೨ (7-12) where its embedded English footnote says Ch. VII. 1. 2; applied 7-12 in the English block line
Kannada p.342 prints ಕ್ರಿ. ಪೂ. ೫೦೨ (502 BC) for the Buddhism date where the English had 500; applied 502

Kannada p.380 prose places the four-horned mantra in the 3rd Mandala, 58th Sukta, 3rd Rik, while the Sanskrit line printed above it gives Ṛ. ೪-೫೮-೩; English keeps RV 4-58-3 (from the Sanskrit line); no English prose number to change
Kannada p.379: 17 priests including the yajamana may not perform the yajna, sadasya the 18th (Shatapatha Br. 10-4-1-9); applied as printed (English had 16 / seventeenth)
Kannada p.384 prints no sutra number or name for the 'avijneyat' sutra (1-2-38 in the English); number removed

The English has no section for printed pp. 372–373 (Yāska's reply, Bādarāyaṇa's abhimāni-vyapadeśa, the Rudra answer) and p. 371 ends mid-sentence; not added (omissions are not added in the second pass): a translation of these two pages is needed
Kannada p.423 says Brahma-sutra third adhyaya first pada for asadvyapadesan neti chen na..., while its own citation is Ve. Su. 2-1-17 (second adhyaya); English has third, as printed
Kannada p.426 cites Taittiriya Samhita 2-1-4 in the bhashya and 2-1-1 in the anuvada for sa atmano vapam udakhidat; English has 2-1-1 (prose), as printed

Kannada has no printed mark for 409, 422, 428 (a 'NOT IN THE SUPPLIED TEXT' mark follows): the text of 409 sits at the end of block 408, that of 422 at the end of 421, that of 428 at the end of 427; English has its own Page 409/422/428 sections and lines up with them
Kannada p.447 (Aditi/Tai. Saṃ. 6-1-5 example and Sutra context) has no English section; English p.446 notes the jump to 448; no translation added
English p.446 ends mid-sentence "As the divine..." and p.448 begins "...the divine"; the text of Kannada p.447 lies between
Kannada pages 437, 445, 453 end with a stray printed number (58, 59, 60) that is not in the English
Kannada ref (ತ್ರೈ. ಬ್ರಾ. ೧-೧೪) applied as printed (English now 1-14; English had 1-1-4)
Kannada p.472 prints the reference of the Jaiminiya Nyayamala verses as (ಜೈ ನ್ಯಾ. ೧೧-೮); the other Nyayamala references are of the form 1-2-1, 2-1-7; applied as printed (English now 11-8)
Kannada p.481 gives the sutra for tac codakesu mantrakhya as (Purva Mimamsa 2-1-32, 33), p.484 as (Jai. Su. 3-1-32); English p.484 keeps 3-1-32 as printed on p.484
Kannada p.473 has no head of its own in the supplied text: its text follows the second head 'Sayanabhasyabhumika' inside the block of p.472 and corresponds to English '### Page 473'
Kannada p.562 prints the reference of the quotation as (Ri. Sam. 10-20-2); the verse is in hymn 71 of Mandala 10; applied as printed (English now 10-20-2)
Kannada p.569 refers to the earlier explanation of catvari on (40 ne) page 40; English had page 401; applied as printed

Kannada p.573 has no head of its own: its text follows the page header 573 inside the block of p.572 and corresponds to English ### Page 573; Kannada p.574 has no text in the supplied Kannada, English ### Page 574 (Sarasvati, Dasamyam putrasya) has nothing to compare with
